idea-plugin.name: WCAG 2.1 AA Legal Baseline Audit for templates
idea-plugin.description:
Audits HTML, JSX, Vue, Twig, Blade, ERB and Razor markup against the 24 WCAG 2.1 Level AA checks that 28 CFR 35.200 and EN 301 549 actually name - not WCAG 2.2.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → WCAG 2.1 AA Legal Baseline Audit for templates: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 24 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/wcag21-aa-legal-baseline-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/wcag21-aa-legal-baseline-audit
